title: QUIKRETE Construction Grade Mortar Mix of Masonry Cement and Graded Sand for Laying Brick, Concrete Units, and Stone, 10 Pounds
description:
About this item
QUIKRETE Construction Grade Mortar Mix of Masonry Cement and Graded Sand for Laying Brick, Concrete Units, and Stone, 10 Pounds
reviews_5s:
Yes, excellent product -- but as another reviewer has pointed out, you can buy this same bag for <$5 at your local hardware or home store. It was nice, though, to have it delivered this one time.A little pricy compared to what you can get at a big box store. You could literally get a 5x bigger bag for a similar price (or maybe even cheaper). But I just wanted something for a small brick tucking project that shipped free and fast and didn't want to have a giant bag left over. If you have a large project definitely go to a hardware store and get a big bag as it will be orders of magnitude cheaper.It came in just a perfect size and it's a wonderful Product to use when you're touching up gaps between bricks on structures such as stairs. I didn't need a huge bag of this and this size worked out well.It is a solid brand of concrete. This company has many type of mixes.
I used this one for a more solid seat to the bricks and adhesive type, plus it will set pretty face.
A easy mix with water, mind that, you will have to decide how thick and it also makes a difference with the temperature you are working with .....
But it is a good brand ... .Good stuffFirst time ever patching concrete. Working with quikrete made it so easy.It’s concrete many applications and uses next time. I will buy it in a local store.It worksPerfectgreat product
reviews_1s:
This is NOT a normal concrete - it is a few cups of concrete! NOT OKAY! $20 for a few cups of concrete mix!!! Can but this in larger quantities anywhere for $5!! BUYER BEWARE!!My family has been using Quikrete for a while now and it has always been quality product, whether you buy this particular for tuck pointing, brick laying or any thing in between or you use their other fine products like the type N, type N, type M or their Portland cement, you'll always end up satisfied. The problem was the cement I ordered was not Quikrete, it was way too brittle, either didn't form correctly and turned to dust whenever it did. The other problem is the seller's ridiculous price gouging, he's selling 10 pounds for $17.43 when you can get an 60 pound for just under $7.00. Now I understand that not everyone can or wants to go deal in store, or just doesn't have a Home depot or Lowe's or Menards but even so, this would be considered an upcharge.Buyer beware....not a 6 pack like the picture says!

Edit 10-19-24 they took the 6 pack sign off the picture after the complaint.Save yourself time and money and just buy Portland mortar at the store. 80lb for like 10$ and it's WAY better, easier to apply, etc. I can't believe I paid $16 for this small bag of brown mortarThe description of the product is misleading you are actually getting a 10lb bag for 20 dollars not a 60lb bag. The bag was ripped open and damaged. They will let you return it AT YOUR COST. So it’s pointless to even try to return. This is not something you should purchase online.Can get a 60lb bag for under 7 bucksYou receive a tiny bag. No label. No instruction. Its NOT the bag pictured. Have to pay to return. Price per pound is much higher than in stores. I should've read the reviews.I couldn’t use the product. It wasn’t working like Cement all would. Waste of my timeThe smallest bag for a big price, had to be a joke.Morter mix is fine, BAG open and 1/4 removed, RE-Wrapped and shipped.

This seller is BAD news. STAY AWAY
